name: Vöhringen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, blue and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Vöhringen (a white wavy bend sinister with a fleur-de-lis and cogwheel on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Vöhringen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Vöhringen arms — wavy bend, fleur-de-lis and cogwheel
